title: fix(desktop): put the unsaved dot back on the left of the title bar path (#5467)
issueTitle: Unsaved dot moved from the left of the title bar path to the right of the filename
why: The only difference is where a small text-less dot sits relative to the title-bar path, and that depends on the custom title bar style being on for Linux, so there is no exact visible text to check and the result is unreliable.
